plugins.name: carbide
plugins.description: Run and configure your contracting operations from Claude Code.

skills.name: carbide-appointment-scheduling
skills.description: Find real Carbide appointment availability and book, extend, relocate, or cancel appointments. Use when scheduling must account for estimators, routing, calendars, travel, and conflicts.
skills.description_zh: 查询Carbide真实预约空档并预订、延长、迁移或取消预约，综合估价人员、路线、日历、交通和冲突。

skills.name: carbide-customer-and-request-operations
skills.description: Find, create, and update Carbide contacts, companies, properties, requests, contact methods, notes, assignments, and outcomes. Use for CRM and intake operations, not organization-wide configuration.
skills.name_hint: carbide · 客户 · and · 请求 · operations
skills.description_zh: 查询、创建和更新Carbide联系人、公司、物业、请求、联系渠道、笔记、分配及结果，用于CRM与受理，不用于全组织配置。

skills.name: carbide-diagnostics-and-health
skills.description: Diagnose Carbide setup, booking, integrations, records, and background jobs using health checks and behavioral evidence. Use when explaining why Carbide behaved a certain way or what setup remains incomplete.
skills.name_hint: carbide · diagnostics · and · 健康状态
skills.description_zh: 通过健康检查和行为证据诊断Carbide设置、预约、集成、记录及后台任务，解释异常行为或尚未完成的设置。

skills.name: carbide-intake-public-page-and-communications
skills.description: Configure Carbide intake choices, request links, public booking content, reminders, notification templates, email identity, and referral communication. Use for customer-facing setup and messaging.
headings: Carbide intake, public page, and communications
skills.name_hint: carbide · intake · public · page · and · communications
skills.description_zh: 配置Carbide客户受理选项、请求链接、公开预约内容、提醒、通知模板、邮件身份与转介沟通，用于面向客户的设置和消息。

skills.name: carbide-integrations-webhooks-and-api-keys
skills.description: Inspect and configure Carbide integrations, CRM synchronization, webhooks, custom booking domains, and API keys. Use for administrator-owned external-service setup and troubleshooting.
headings: Carbide integrations, webhooks, and API keys
skills.name_hint: carbide · 集成 · webhooks · and · api · keys
skills.description_zh: 检查配置Carbide集成、CRM同步、Webhook、自定义预约域名和API密钥，用于管理员负责的外部服务设置与排错。

skills.name: carbide-operational-reporting
skills.description: Summarize and analyze Carbide customers, requests, appointments, jobs, and workload without changing records. Use for operational status, counts, trends, queues, and follow-up questions.
skills.description_zh: 只读汇总分析Carbide客户、请求、预约、任务及工作量，报告运营状态、数量、趋势、队列与后续问题。

skills.name: carbide-organization-team-and-routing
skills.description: Audit and configure Carbide organization profile, members, staff roles, estimator routing, availability, territories, crews, trades, skills, and requirements. Use for administrative setup and team routing.
skills.description_zh: 审计配置Carbide组织资料、成员角色、估价人员路由、可用时间、区域、班组、工种、技能和要求，用于团队管理与路由。

skills.name: carbide-phone-agents
skills.description: Inspect, create, update, and pause Carbide phone agents when the organization has the phone-agents feature. Use for voice-agent configuration, not ordinary customer phone records.
skills.description_zh: 在组织已启用电话智能体功能时，检查、创建、修改或暂停Carbide电话智能体；不用于普通客户电话号码记录。

skills.name: carbide-production-management
skills.description: Manage Carbide production jobs, scope, teams, blocks, crews, constraints, colors, checklists, and project check-ins. Use for job planning and execution after a request reaches production.
skills.description_zh: 在请求进入生产执行后管理Carbide任务、范围、团队、区块、班组、约束、颜色、清单及项目检查，用于规划执行。
